_comment: Manifest for scripts/check_dng_ffi_artifacts.py. Data only — adding or flipping a platform must never require editing the checker script. Governance: per-feature preference cascade (C-8/P-1) stands (2026-08-24). RAW decoder ships macOS+Windows+Android today. Linux .so is open item P-2, not a blocker. No iOS entry — iOS FFI is superseded by the future general raw_decoder effort (see plan Dropped section), not part of this manifest.

macos.comment: Vendored arm64 dylib; ruling P-12 confirmed this symbol is exported.

windows.comment: Trust-on-first-use: built on a real Windows host (commit d36e1bd) but no S4 colour-gate run recorded. dumpbin is unavailable on non-Windows hosts, so this platform legitimately reports symbol=skipped when checked from macOS/Linux.

linux.comment: Open item P-2: Linux .so does not exist yet. Flip 'expected' to true the day it lands; no script changes needed.
